summary: Iter41 - Tested refactored AdminPanelFullPage (frontend) + new Stripe Issuing routes gating (backend). Backend: 10/11 pytest tests passed - CRITICAL bug: GET /api/issuing/cards is NOT gated (returns 200 instead of 503). Frontend: admin panel sections, search, filter tabs, detail views all working. CRITICAL UX bug: after toggling to Grid layout mode, the grid view (AdminPage.jsx) is missing the layout-toggle button -> user stuck in grid mode unless localStorage is manually cleared.

critical.issue: Missing _require_enabled() guard. When STRIPE_ISSUING_ENABLED=false, endpoint returns 200 with empty {cards:[],count:0} instead of 503. Same issue also for GET /api/issuing/cardholders/me (no guard in code - returns 404 'Kein Cardholder vorhanden' if authenticated, leaking endpoint existence).

ui_bugs.issue: After user clicks layout-toggle in AdminPanelFullPage to switch to Grid, the rendered AdminPage grid view does NOT expose a data-testid='layout-toggle' button. AdminPage.jsx also does not accept/use the onToggleLayout prop passed by AdminPanelFullPage. Consequence: user is trapped in grid mode with no UI way back to list mode (must clear localStorage admin_layout_mode manually). Confirmed: after toggle, localStorage set to 'grid' but layout-toggle selector returns null in DOM.

action_items: Add `_require_enabled()` call to `@router.get('/api/issuing/cards')` and `@router.get('/api/issuing/cardholders/me')` in /app/backend/routes/stripe_issuing.py so ALL /api/issuing/* endpoints return 503 when STRIPE_ISSUING_ENABLED=false (currently only the POSTs are gated).

Update /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.jsx to (a) accept `layoutMode` and `onToggleLayout` props forwarded from AdminPanelFullPage, and (b) render a button with data-testid='layout-toggle' that calls onToggleLayout so user can switch back to list view. Without this, toggling to Grid is a one-way trap.
critical_code_review_comments: stripe_issuing.py GET endpoints missing enablement gate — inconsistent with declared design (line 88-96 helper exists but unused on GETs).
AdminPanelFullPage.jsx passes onToggleLayout/layoutMode to <AdminPageGrid/> via Suspense lazy import (line 90), but AdminPage.jsx ignores those props — dead prop passing.

dataLoaders.js loadAdminDetail uses `onNavigate(item.nav)` which relies on state-based SPA router without URL change — testable only by component swap, not url. Works but harder to test via URL assertions.
Frontend logs show repeated 401 errors on initial load (pre-login) — likely /api/auth/me probe; consider suppressing noise or gating early network calls on auth state.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all section/testid checks pass; 1 UX trap in grid mode)

rca of the issue: GET /api/issuing/cards bug RCA: In /app/backend/routes/stripe_issuing.py line 222-227, the `list_my_cards` handler only calls `get_current_user(request)` but omits `_require_enabled()`, unlike the POST handlers (lines 120, 184, 237, 259) which correctly guard. GET /api/issuing/cardholders/me (line 169-176) has the same omission. Fix: prepend `_require_enabled()` as the first call inside both handlers. Grid toggle RCA: AdminPanelFullPage.jsx toggleLayout() writes localStorage and passes onToggleLayout to AdminPageGrid, but AdminPage.jsx (destination component) contains no 'layout-toggle' element and ignores the prop. Fix: add a toggle button in AdminPage's header that calls props.onToggleLayout when provided.
